title: TANF federal time-limit framework
facts: Federal TANF rules generally prohibit using federal TANF assistance for a family that includes an adult who has received federally funded assistance for 60 cumulative months, subject to statutory exceptions and hardship provisions.
States may set shorter limits under state policy and may use certain state funds under different rules.
The 60-month federal framework is not a promise that every family can receive 60 months of cash assistance.
